verified.exploit: the factory deploys a strategy with an empty pool, so the first depositor seeds one wei, donates assets straight to the contract and makes the next honest deposit mint zero shares
verified.poc_sketch: deploy via newStrategy -> deposit 1 wei -> transfer assets in -> victim deposits -> redeem the pool

verified.exploit: the accounting getter reports a total that still ignores an unreported loss, so depositing just before the loss is booked buys shares at a stale price and dilutes existing holders
verified.poc_sketch: observe the pending loss -> deposit -> wait for the loss to be booked -> withdraw at the corrected price

verified.exploit: the tick-range width is narrowed into a uint16 after a wider multiplication, so a wide range wraps to a tiny value and every later position is opened against the corrupted range, reverting all new deposits
verified.poc_sketch: open a position with a range wide enough to overflow the uint16 width -> every subsequent deposit reverts
